randomrun.loading.tip.1: One block in the Nether is eight in the Overworld. A portal trip there cuts the distance by eight.
randomrun.loading.tip.2: A water bucket placed under you cancels fall damage from any height.
randomrun.loading.tip.3: Bad spawn? The pause menu has a "Change seed" button.
randomrun.loading.tip.4: Sprint-jumping is faster than plain sprinting.
randomrun.loading.tip.5: Beds explode in the Nether, which makes them handy for mining ancient debris.
randomrun.loading.tip.6: A carved pumpkin on your head lets you look endermen in the eye.
randomrun.loading.tip.7: Gold tools mine faster than diamond ones but break quickly.
randomrun.loading.tip.8: Buried treasure always holds a Heart of the Sea. Shipwreck chests often have the map.
randomrun.loading.tip.9: Piglins trade gold ingots for ender pearls, obsidian and fire resistance potions.
randomrun.loading.tip.10: A lava bucket in a furnace smelts 100 items.
randomrun.loading.tip.11: A hay bale reduces fall damage by 80%.
randomrun.loading.tip.12: An Eye of Ender breaks 20% of the time. Bring spares.
randomrun.loading.tip.13: A netherite ingot takes 4 netherite scraps and 4 gold ingots.
randomrun.loading.tip.15: Compasses spin in the Nether. Use a lodestone there.

randomrun.loading.tip.16: Ruined portal chests often contain obsidian, gold and flint and steel.
randomrun.loading.tip.17: Slimes spawn in swamps and in slime chunks below Y 40.
randomrun.loading.tip.18: Witches drop glowstone dust, redstone and sugar.
randomrun.loading.tip.19: Desert temple chests usually give gunpowder, bones and gold.
randomrun.loading.tip.20: Cartographers sell maps to woodland mansions and ocean monuments.
randomrun.loading.tip.21: A custom seed is good for practicing a route, but that run won't reach the leaderboard.
randomrun.loading.tip.22: You can invite a friend right from the room. They won't need the password.
randomrun.loading.tip.23: The "Unobtainable" setting decides whether the roulette can roll items you can't get in survival.
randomrun.loading.tip.24: Bastions hide netherite scraps and plenty of gold, but they are dangerous.
